message: Hi, I'm a student with a full stack certification background. My overall academic average is 76.8% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in cloud computing and developer. I want to become a Software Systems Engineer. My family can afford at most about USD 1200 per year. I live in Pune. I cannot leave my city. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

constraints.career_goal: Software Systems Engineer (interested in cloud computing and developer roles)

reflection_note: All programs on the initial shortlist (PR0019, PR0180, PR0045, PR0190) violate the hard budget constraint ($1200 max). This is a critical issue. I dropped all of them. Among the remaining candidates, only PR0023 meets the budget requirement ($650). Although its focus (Cybersecurity) is slightly off from 'Software Systems Engineer' and 'Cloud Computing', it is the *only* viable option that respects the student's financial limitations while matching the location preference (Pune). I have added PR0023 as the sole recommendation. The budget constraint is extremely restrictive for high-quality technical programs in this set.
explanation:
Silverline Technical University
This program was recommended because it perfectly aligns with your fixed preference for Pune and remains significantly under your maximum budget, costing only $650 USD annually. Furthermore, its 70% placement rate addresses your high priority on employability, and your academic background (76.8%) easily surpasses the minimum required grade of 57%. The main trade-off here is that while you are aiming for Software Systems Engineering, this MTech specializes in Cyber Security, requiring a shift in focus from pure development roles.
